create_granite_config_default: create a GraniteConfig instance with default hyperparameters for the granite-3b style model
create_granite_config_from_checkpoint: create a GraniteConfig instance initialized from the ibm-granite/granite-3.0-8b-base checkpoint
build_granite_model_from_config: build a GraniteModel instance using a GraniteConfig configuration object
access_model_config: access the GraniteConfig from an existing GraniteModel instance via model.config
customize_granite_hyperparameters: customize GraniteConfig hyperparameters including hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and rope_parameters
